subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Themselves**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a reflexive pronoun to match the subject of the sentence.
 
• In the sentence, the word "**themselves**" is necessary to complete the thought.
 
• It refers to individuals who have experienced rejection.
 
• The subject is likely plural, as the only options given are plural pronouns.
 
• The most appropriate reflexive pronoun for a plural subject is "**themselves**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• "**Himself**", "**Yourself**," and "**Itself**" are singular reflexive pronouns and do not match the likely plural subject.
